title: Upgrade your Working with Children Check from volunteer to paid
summary: Learn how to upgrade your Working with Children Check (WWCC) clearance from a volunteer status to a paid status.
intro:
People engaged in paid child-related work must hold a paid Working with Children Check (WWCC) clearance.

If you hold a volunteer WWCC clearance, and you start paid child-related work, it is a legal requirement that you upgrade your WWCC clearance from volunteer to paid within 30 days of beginning the paid work.

The fee for a paid worker WWCC is $107.
who_can_apply: People engaged in paid child-related work
Individuals who hold a volunteer WWCC clearance and are starting paid child-related work

how_to_steps.text: Complete the online form ensuring the name you enter matches your identity documents exactly.
Visit a Service NSW Centre to present your original identity documents and pay the fee.

faqs.q: Do I need to upgrade my WWCC if I start paid child-related work?
faqs.a: Yes. If you hold a volunteer WWCC clearance and start paid child-related work, you must upgrade your WWCC clearance from volunteer to paid within 30 days of beginning the paid work.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to get a paid WWCC?
faqs.a: The fee for a paid worker WWCC is $107.

faqs.q: What do I need to upgrade my WWCC?
faqs.a: You need your WWCC number and proof of identity.
